mutation_directive: agent-system / boids radiolarian: replace the Lenia continuous-field substrate with a genuine MULTI-AGENT SYSTEM. 65k autonomous GPU agents (position+velocity in ping-pong FloatTextures, an update pass per frame) integrate boids rules — separation / alignment / cohesion over a sampled local neighbourhood — PLUS a radial symmetry field (concentric-shell attractor + N-fold spoke/strut snapping). The radiolarian skeleton EMERGES from agent interaction, not a baked mask: streamer agents flow along the spokes, orbiter agents drift around the shells, and a slow wander re-routes them. SYM-fold rotational replication makes the colony read as a radially-symmetric Haeckel specimen instantly; faint feedback trails reveal the flows. ThoughtTrace signals drive symmetry order (5..12), agent speed, flock cohesion, shell count and palette. Haeckel Kunstformen identity kept: jewel-toned amber/verdigris/garnet, ivory linework, sepia plate frame.
